payout_quote: When they open a checking account and make 20 debit card purchases or reach $500 in direct deposits within 60 days, you will each get $100 deposited into your account. By making a valid referral that is completed by a Friend Participant in accordance with the Promotion and these Terms, each Participant will receive a cash Bonus of $100.00 on or about the 61st day after the opening of the Friend Participant's Checking Account.
steps: Generate your referral code from Michigan First's Refer-a-Friend page.
Share the code with a friend or family member who is eligible for membership and has no current or charged-off Credit Union account.
They apply through the Credit Union's digital channels with your referral code and open a qualifying checking account.
Within 60 days they receive $500+ in direct deposits or complete 20 debit card purchase transactions, with no negative balance or unpaid fees at day 60.
On or about the 61st day, $100 is deposited into each of your accounts.
catches: Limited time offer — terms subject to change.
Friend participant must not have a current Credit Union account as a primary or joint holder and must not have a previously held account that was charged off.
Within 60 days, new checking must receive direct deposits totaling $500+ or activate a debit card and complete 20 purchase transactions.
No outstanding unpaid overdraft or Courtesy Pay fees and no negative balance at the end of the 60-day period.
Both participants must be at least 17 years of age.
Referring member must have a Credit Union account in good standing.
Friend must present a validly generated referral code and apply through the Credit Union's digital channels.
Bonus paid as cash on or about the 61st day after the friend's account opening.
biggest_catch: Limited-time offer; friend must have no current or previously charged-off Credit Union account; within 60 days the new checking must receive $500+ in direct deposits or complete 20 debit purchases and end the 60-day period with no negative balance or unpaid overdraft/Courtesy Pay fees.
eligibility: Referrer must have a Credit Union account in good standing; friend must be 17+, meet membership eligibility, have no current Credit Union account and no prior account charged off by the Credit Union.
timing: Referral share takes ~5-15 minutes active; $100 cash deposited to each participant on or about the 61st day after the friend's account opening.

payout_value_note: $100 cash to referrer per qualified referral (friend also gets $100); no count cap stated.
numeric_basis: payout $100 flat per referral from official terms; time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
when_cash_arrives: Referral share takes ~5-15 minutes active; $100 cash deposited to each participant on or about the 61st day after the friend's account opening. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
